description: This PHP source file defines the OutboundEmailAccounts class, extending OutboundEmailAccounts_sugar, for managing outbound email account configurations within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, access control, and UI components related to outbound email account settings.

classes.name: OutboundEmailAccounts
classes.description: Class for managing outbound email account configurations, including save, retrieve, access control, and UI functions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the outbound email account, handling authentication and settings.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves an outbound email account record, decoding sensitive data.

methods.name: getUserOutboundAccounts
methods.description: Returns a list of outbound email accounts accessible to the current user.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Creates a query for listing outbound email accounts with user access filtering.

methods.name: hasAccessToPersonalAccount
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to the personal account.

methods.name: logPersonalAccountAccessDenied
methods.description: Logs an access denied event for personal account access.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Determines if the current user has access to perform a specific action based on ACL rules.

methods.name: getFromAddress
methods.description: Returns the 'from' email address for outbound emails.

methods.name: getFromName
methods.description: Returns the 'from' name for outbound emails.

methods.name: keepWriteOnlyFieldValues
methods.description: Ensures write-only fields are populated from fetched data.

methods.name: getPasswordChange
methods.description: Returns HTML for password change UI component.

methods.name: getEmailProviderChooser
methods.description: Returns HTML for email provider selection UI.

methods.name: getSendTestEmailBtn
methods.description: Returns HTML and JavaScript for the 'Send Test Email' button and dialog.

methods.name: isAdminOnlyAction
methods.description: Checks if a view/action is admin-only.

methods.name: isSecurityGroupBasedAction
methods.description: Checks if a view/action is security group-based.

methods.name: isNotAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if a view/action is not allowed.
